title: ISLAND-GEO-022: Independent monotonic root and fail-closed production security

root_protocol.transport: AF_UNIX with kernel SO_PEERCRED, remote UID pinning
root_protocol.guarantee: authenticity and freshness conditional on key and root process integrity; NOT independent anti-rollback without protected monotonic backend

permit_protocol: direct client issue over SO_PEERCRED; broker-only consume; exactly-once durable SQLite state-bound to witness head
witness: witness-owned SQLite; CAS mirrors to external root and denies divergence; no auto-repair after split CAS crash
strict_admission: Reject before DB access / lease / socket publication if OS-MAC, hardware root and independent service manager are not all independently verified
os_mac: Independent real loaded LSM profile assessment required; labels or DAC permissions alone insufficient
service_manager: Independent PID1/supervisor, pre-exec domain confinement and lifecycle restart with measured service credentials mandatory; not installed
